name: Dollar auction
summary: A non-zero sum escalation auction where the highest bidder wins a dollar but the second-highest also pays its bid.
rules_text: An auctioneer offers a $1 bill. Players alternately raise the current high bid by at least a fixed minimum increment, e.g. $0.05, starting at $0.05. The current high bidder and the amount are public. On your turn you may drop out or raise above the current high bid. If you drop out you are out of the auction. When no player is willing to raise, the auction ends. The final high bidder receives $1 and pays their bid for a net payoff of 1 - bid. The second-highest bidder pays their last bid and receives nothing, payoff -bid. All other bidders who dropped earlier pay their last bids as well.
rating_reason: Classic sequential bidding game illustrating escalation
